🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL per supplied regime; Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, a reading of Sector Weakness. Risk and cycle signals are N/A, so breadth alone does not justify overriding the regime; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but no clear style leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples, Utilities and Communication are the relative leaders, though all three sectors were negative over 1W. KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%), DUK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +8.10%) and DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) led within those groups.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology, Materials and Healthcare were the weakest sectors over 1W, down 6.94%, 5.28% and 4.42%, respectively. NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -17.18% | 1M: -25.29%) and UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) underscore the pressure.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +3.19% | 1M: -4.21%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%), DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) and CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +26.50%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors); TJX is a short-term rebound, not a confirmed trend turn.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -4.86%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -13.01%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.29% | 1M: -13.15%), NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -11.77% | 1M: -10.51%) and NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -11.84% | 1M: -39.42%). Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with Materials also under pressure.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W gainers included KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +3.19% | 1M: -4.21%) and AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%). TJX and PANW RECOVERY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -0.11%) are short-term rebounds; watch for trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of 1W: -6.94% and 1M: -12.26%; aggregate breadth is 0/11 sectors positive. AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%) is an exception, while AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +3.89%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -4.43%) and NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) show broad pressure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak on the week, with sector returns of 1W: -3.60% and 1M: -0.22%; aggregate breadth is 0/11 sectors positive. JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -3.33%), V CORRECTION (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +2.32%) and MA CORRECTION (1W: -2.63% | 1M: +3.70%) show a pullback with mixed timeframes.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of 1W: -4.42% and 1M: -0.72%; aggregate breadth is 0/11 sectors positive. LLY CORRECTION (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +7.85%) and JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -2.75% | 1M: +5.14%) retain positive 1M returns, while UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) is a notable laggard.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay selective in the supplied NEUTRAL regime; there is no confirmed sector-wide style leadership, so style is mixed. Monitor relative strength in KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) and AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%), while managing exposure to persistent weakness in NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) and TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.51%) have positive price confirmation; monitor whether strength persists. BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) and UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) remain at risk unless selling pressure eases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples had the least-negative weekly sector return at -0.18%, but remains below zero; watch for broader confirmation. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.94%; 1M: -12.26%) and Materials (1W: -5.28%; 1M: +0.58%) remain weak, with aggregate breadth at 0/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Spot-price levels were not supplied, so monitor return-based triggers instead: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) for stabilization, and JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -3.33%) for a return to positive 1W momentum. AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +3.89%) and LLY CORRECTION (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +7.85%) need renewed weekly strength to confirm their positive 1M trends.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+70): Health Canada approved Mounjaro to reduce cardiovascular risk; LLY CORRECTION (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +7.85%) diverges from the positive catalyst on a weekly basis. DIS (+65): Earnings beat and a $3 billion savings plan drew analyst target increases; DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) confirms the news. INTC (+55): First external customer for its 18A chip technology; INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -12.53% | 1M: -40.38%) diverges sharply from the positive headline. TGT (+50): Raised full-year sales outlook; TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.51%) confirms the catalyst.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (-55): Downgrade and weakness in metals; FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -17.18% | 1M: -25.29%) confirms the negative tone. NEM (-40): Precious and industrial metals sold off; NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -11.77% | 1M: -10.51%) confirms weakness. META (-35): $225 billion AI spending forecast raised cash-flow concerns; META BELOW TREND (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -11.22%) confirms pressure. UNH (-35): Proposed CMS anti-fraud rules weighed on insurers; UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) also confirms the negative sentiment.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with 0/11 sectors positive and no confirmed Growth-versus-Value leadership; Top 5 leadership is broad across four sectors. KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%), DIS ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) and AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%) show relative strength. Monitor broad sector weakness and the divergence between positive INTC news and INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -12.53% | 1M: -40.38%).
